DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin Lymphoma or Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma).

Based on the classic B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) combined with massive, widespread lymphadenopathy on CT and normal blood work, this presentation is highly suggestive of a lymphoproliferative disorder.
